info.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS REST API
info.description:
RESTful API for managing Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS next-generation firewalls. Provides programmatic access to configure firewall policies, objects, network interfaces, and device settings. The API follows a resource-oriented design with standard HTTP methods for CRUD operations. Authentication uses an API key passed in the X-PAN-KEY header, generated from the PAN-OS web interface under Device > Administrators or via the /api/?type=keygen XML API endpoint. All configuration changes are staged in candidate configuration and require a commit to take effect.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
